note: Ps48 Zion psalm (corrected method). Human IB: halal/tehillah praise, enemy kings' inner collapse (tamah astounded / bahal panic / raad trembling / chil anguish), samach/gil Zion's gladness+rejoicing, lev 'consider well' the ramparts. God-acts/attributes (yada made-known, shabar shattered, chesed, tsedeq righteousness, mishpat judgments) = qualifiers. Place/cosmic (holy, joy-of-earth, fortress, wind, name) = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: God made known as a fortress in Zion (v3)
greatly, in the city of God

'Great is the LORD and greatly to be PRAISED (halal) in the city of our God!' — the exuberant praise of the great God enthroned in Zion; halal here the worship the people render, grounded in God who has made himself known within her as a fortress (v3 = the qualifier)

'As soon as they saw it, they were ASTOUNDED (tamah); they were in panic; they took to flight' — the enemy kings' inner collapse at the sight of God's city; tamah the stunned amazement that seizes the foes, the first of the terror-sequence (astounded/panic/trembling/anguish) grounded in God's shattering power (v7)
'they were in PANIC (bahal); they took to flight' — the terror that routs the kings; bahal (recurs Ps30:7) the dismay/panic that follows their amazement, driving them to flee God's impregnable city
'TREMBLING (raad) took hold of them there' — the physical seizure of terror; raad the shuddering that grips the fleeing kings, the body registering the soul's dread
as of a woman in labour

'ANGUISH (chil) as of a woman in labour' — writhing distress imaged as birth-pangs; chil the labouring agony that convulses the terrified kings, the extremity of their inner collapse before God's city
prompted by God's steadfast love, meditated in the temple (v9)
to the ends of the earth

'As your name, so your PRAISE (tehillah) reaches to the ends of the earth' — the worldwide praise of God matching his name; tehillah here the praise the people offer, welling from meditating his steadfast love in the temple (v9 = the qualifier), his right hand full of righteousness
be glad (samach - let Mount Zion be glad)

'Let Mount Zion be GLAD (samach)!' — the joy of God's city at his righteous rule; samach the gladness of Zion, called forth by God's judgments (v11 qualifier), the worshipping city rejoicing in its King
God's judgments, the occasion of joy (v11)

'Let the daughters of Judah REJOICE (gil) because of your judgments!' — exultation at God's righteous acts; gil the joy of Judah's daughters, occasioned by God's judgments (the qualifier), the moral order that gladdens the faithful
heart / set the mind (lev - consider well)

'Consider WELL (set your heart, lev) her ramparts... that you may tell the next generation' — attentive contemplation of Zion to pass on the testimony; lev here the mind/heart set deliberately on God's city, the reflective attention that becomes teaching for the generations
make known / reveal (yada niphal - God as fortress)

v3 QUALIFIER (God's self-revelation): 'Within her citadels God has made himself KNOWN (yada) as a fortress' - God's self-disclosure is not a human IB char; the ground of the people's praise (279161). Qualifier.
shatter / break (shabar - God shattered the ships)
God's power that terrifies the kings (v7->v5)
v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'By the east wind you SHATTERED (shabar) the ships of Tarshish' - God's shattering is not a human IB char; the display of power behind the kings' terror (279228). Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - meditated in the temple)
the chesed the people meditate, welling into praise (v9->v10)

v9 QUALIFIER (God's chesed): 'We have thought on your STEADFAST LOVE (chesed), O God, in the midst of your temple' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; it is the object of the people's meditation, welling into their praise (279171). Qualifier. (The 'thinking on' verb is unflagged; chesed is its object.)
righteousness (tsedeq - right hand full of it)

v10 QUALIFIER (God's righteousness): 'Your right hand is filled with RIGHTEOUSNESS (tsedeq)' - God's righteousness is not a human IB char; the divine attribute the people's praise celebrates (279171). Qualifier.
God's judgments, the occasion of the daughters' joy (v11)
v11 QUALIFIER (God's acts): 'rejoice because of your JUDGMENTS (mishpat)' - God's judgments are not a human IB char; the occasion of the daughters' rejoicing (279183). Qualifier.
v1: 'His HOLY (qodesh) mountain' - the holiness of Zion, God's mountain; an attribute of the place, not an inner operation. Standalone.
joy / delight (masos - joy of all the earth)

v2: 'beautiful in elevation, the JOY (masos) of all the earth, Mount Zion' - masos here an attribute of Zion (the joy/delight it is to all the earth), a quality of the place, not the inner operation of a worshipper. Standalone.

v3: 'God has made himself known as a FORTRESS (misgab)' - the stronghold God is within Zion's citadels; a designation of God-as-refuge (paired with the self-revelation 306337), the object more than an inner operation. Standalone.
v7: 'By the east WIND (ruach) you shattered the ships' - ruach here literal wind, God's instrument of judgement; a physical means, not an inner operation. Standalone.
hear (shama - as we have heard, so have we seen)

v8: 'As we have HEARD (shama), so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts' - the people's confirmation of tradition by sight; the reception of report, closely tied to the confident praise. Standalone.
name (shem - as your name, so your praise)
v10: 'As your NAME (shem), O God, so your praise reaches to the ends of the earth' - God's name/renown, matched by his praise (279171); a divine title, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v14: 'this is God, our God FOREVER (olam) and ever' - the eternity of God's covenant relation; a time-word, not an inner operation. Standalone.
